email.body:
Dear Operations,

MV EYOT SPRING, Krishnapatnam to Ravenna

In view of last night's security advisory for the southern Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, owners will not send the vessel through Bab el-Mandeb. This is our decision under the war risks clause.

Kindly give other orders; owners suggest the route round the Cape of Good Hope. The Master is holding a course clear of the area until he hears from you.

Best regards,
Marine department
Owner's vessel technical management (Eyot Spring Shipping, fictional)

draft.body:
Dear Owner,

Thank you for your message regarding the Red Sea transit.

We confirm that the Red Sea passage through Bab el-Mandeb has been declined under the war risks clause, and the operator confirms the alternative route round the Cape of Good Hope.

Details of the new route:
- Distance: 10,562.3 nm versus planned 3,588.8 nm (+6,973.5 nm)
- Additional time: 23.2 days at 12.5 kn
- New Ravenna ETA: 2025-02-26T12:00:00Z (+557 h)

Extra time and bunkers resulting from this rerouting are for charterers' account under the war risks clause.

Bunker position: VLSFO on board is about 1,514.4 t, which covers the route with about 613.1 t expected on arrival, above the 3-day reserve of 76.8 t.

Please let us know if you require any further information.

Best regards,
Operations
